purpose: Guide users from beginner to advanced investor through assessment, goals, learning, portfolio review, market context, research practice, and ongoing progress.

stages.name: Investor IQ
stages.job: Assess knowledge, behavior, fund understanding, research confidence, and review discipline.

stages.name: Goal-Based Investing
stages.job: Convert financial goals into portfolio jobs, risk budgets, time horizons, and review cadence.

stages.name: Investor Academy
stages.job: Teach foundations, portfolio construction, research, valuation, retirement income, and behavior.

stages.name: Portfolio Clinic
stages.job: Audit fees, overlap, concentration, tax location, liquidity, policy, and rebalancing rules.

stages.name: Market Pulse
stages.job: Frame valuation, rates, earnings, breadth, risk appetite, flows, and portfolio implications.

stages.name: Research Lab
stages.job: Practice ETF comparison, stock quality analysis, portfolio thesis writing, valuation ranges, and decision logs.

stages.name: Global Markets
stages.job: Build cross-asset context across regions, rates, currencies, commodities, sectors, and global ETFs.
